ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary:  360 ONE WAM LIMITED has declared a Rs. 7.50 interim dividend, which will now be subject to mandatory tax deduction at source (TDS) as per the Income-tax Act, 2025. Shareholders are materially impacted as they must update bank details, ensure PAN-Aadhaar linkage, and upload all requisite tax exemption/lower-rate documents via a dedicated online portal by October 23, 2026. A significant red flag is the company's explicit warning that it will not refund higher taxes deducted due to non-compliance or incomplete submissions, placing the burden solely on shareholders to claim refunds from tax authorities.
